nodes.name: next-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: Auto-generated Next.js ambient type declaration file that pulls in the `next` and `next/image-types/global` type references so TypeScript understands framework globals and image imports. Not meant to be hand-edited.
nodes.languageNotes: Triple-slash `/// <reference types="..." />` directives are the TypeScript mechanism for injecting ambient declarations without an import statement.

nodes.name: next.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Next.js framework configuration that tunes the built-in image optimizer, preferring WebP over AVIF (AVIF softens JPEG portraits at default quality) and declaring a custom device-size breakpoint ladder up to 3840px.
nodes.languageNotes: The `/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */` JSDoc annotation gives a plain `.mjs` file full TypeScript autocompletion and checking without converting it to TypeScript.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the private `anuraag-web` portfolio, declaring the standard Next.js dev/build/start/lint scripts and pinning the runtime stack: Next 14.2, React 18, framer-motion, next-themes, lucide-react, react-github-calendar and the Tailwind class utilities (clsx, tailwind-merge).

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Minimal PostCSS configuration registering Tailwind CSS as the sole plugin, which is what expands the `@tailwind` directives and `@apply` rules in the global stylesheet during the build.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Global stylesheet that loads the three Tailwind layers and defines the site's light/dark design tokens as raw RGB channel triples (`--tw-canvas`, `--tw-ink`, `--tw-line`, ...) on `:root` and `.dark`. Also supplies the decorative `.grain` SVG-noise and `.wash` gradient overlays, wavy-underline treatment, custom selection colors and theming for the GitHub contribution-calendar tooltips.
nodes.languageNotes: Storing colors as space-separated RGB channels (`45 42 51`) rather than full `rgb()` values is what lets Tailwind's `<alpha-value>` placeholder compose opacity modifiers like `bg-canvas/50` on top of CSS-variable-driven themes.

nodes.name: template.tsx
nodes.summary: App Router `template.tsx` client component that wraps every routed page in a framer-motion fade-and-rise transition. Unlike a layout, a template remounts on each navigation, so the animation replays on every route change.
nodes.languageNotes: In the Next.js App Router, `layout.tsx` persists across navigations while `template.tsx` creates a fresh instance per route — the standard place to hang enter animations.

nodes.name: Template
nodes.summary: Default-exported wrapper component that animates its children from transparent/offset/blurred to fully visible over 0.45s with a custom ease curve, collapsing to a plain opacity fade when `useReducedMotion` reports a user preference for reduced motion.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind design-system configuration: enables class-based dark mode, scopes content scanning to src/app, src/components and src/pages, and extends the theme with CSS-variable-backed semantic colors (canvas, surface, ink, line), a pastel and accent palette, three font families, soft/card/lift shadows, and float/wiggle keyframe animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Typing the export as `Config` from `tailwindcss` gives compile-time validation of the whole theme object; the `rgb(var(--token) / <alpha-value>)` pattern bridges CSS custom properties into Tailwind's opacity modifier system.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the Next.js project: strict mode with `noEmit` (Next handles transpilation), bundler module resolution, preserved JSX, incremental builds, the `next` language-service plugin, and the `@/*` path alias mapping to `./src/*`.
